name: 01 — Ingest + Enrich (Refactored)

nodes.name: Search Drive Folder
nodes.notes: Limit 1 — process one file per hourly run. Files queue naturally.

nodes.name: Write All Leads to Source Sheet
nodes.notes: Upsert by pitchbook_url — always present, unique. ALL records written regardless of email.

nodes.name: Delete Source File
nodes.notes: Runs when loop is done (output 0). Clears the processed file from Drive.

nodes.name: Serper Search
nodes.notes: Direct HTTP call — no AI agent. Set credential to your Serper Header Auth credential.

nodes.name: Extract LinkedIn from Results
nodes.notes: Scores candidates by name/company match. Returns empty string if no confident match. Explicitly penalises Reid Hoffman and other LinkedIn corporate false positives.

nodes.name: Update LinkedIn in Source Sheet
nodes.notes: Match key: pitchbook_url. Only writes linkedin_url — does not overwrite other fields.

nodes.name: Back to Loop
nodes.notes: Connect this output to Loop Over Leads input 0 to continue the batch.

nodes.name: Merge Serper + Lead
nodes.notes: Combines Serper HTTP response (input 0) with lead fields from Sanitize Query (input 1). After the HTTP Request node replaces item data, this restores lead context on the same item.

main.node: Write All Leads to Source Sheet

_readme: CREDENTIAL UPDATES REQUIRED AFTER IMPORT:
- All googleDriveOAuth2Api nodes: update to your Drive credential
- All googleSheetsOAuth2Api nodes: consolidate to ONE credential
- Serper Search node: move API key to an n8n HTTP Header Auth credential
then update the X-API-KEY header value to reference $credentials.serperApiKey
SHEET SETUP REQUIRED:
- Rename columns in AutoAdded tab to match canonical schema (see schemas/canonical-lead.js)
- Column order: pitchbook_url, company_name, website_url, first_name, email,
linkedin_url, about, date_added, batch_id, channel, contacted_at
KEY CHANGES FROM ORIGINAL:
- Records WITHOUT email are no longer dropped (If1 removed)
- Merge(combineByPosition) hack removed entirely
- Upsert key changed from Email to pitchbook_url
- LinkedIn enrichment works for all records regardless of email
- channel field computed and stored after enrichment
- Simple Memory removed from AI agent
- File processing limited to 1 file per run (files queue via hourly schedule)
- AI agent removed from LinkedIn lookup entirely — no more hallucinated URLs
- LinkedIn lookup is now: Serper HTTP call → score results by name/company match
- Reid Hoffman and LinkedIn corporate false positives explicitly penalised
- OpenAI no longer called during enrichment (faster, cheaper, no GPT errors)
